reasoning: This repository provides a collection of guardrails detector microservices (huggingface, llm_judge, builtIn) for the FMS Guardrails Orchestrator. Each detector is a FastAPI-based HTTP service packaged as a container image (with individual Dockerfiles), exposing REST APIs such as /api/v1/text/contents and /health. The detectors are designed for deployment on KServe (with InferenceService and ServingRuntime manifests). The project is not a library (it's not consumed as a dependency), not an operator (no CRDs or reconciliation loops), and not configuration-only. It is a set of independently deployable microservices.
